title: invoice.commitment_true_up
description: Plan minimum-commitment true-up (BE-IV-54..57): one customer, one plan with a minimum commitment and one subscription billed by the given runs in order (start, periodic, termination; a terminating run first terminates the subscription at its instant). For every run the output gives the invoice's fees amount and its commitment fee (null when none). Money is EUR (exponent 2); the optional usage charge is an arrears standard charge priced per event.

amount_cents.description: Subscription fee of a full period.

bill_charges_monthly.description: Yearly or semiannual plan whose charges are billed monthly (BE-SP-17).

commitment_amount_cents.description: Minimum commitment of a full plan period.

timezone.description: Effective time zone of the customer (BE-DM-10).

started_at.description: Start (and subscription date) of the subscription.

usage.description: Optional arrears standard charge on a count metric: one event per instant, `amount` (major units) per event.

at.description: Instant of the run (the clock of the billing run).

invoices.description: One entry per run, in run order; null when the run created no invoice.

commitment.description: The commitment fee of the invoice (BE-IV-57), null when none.

from_datetime.description: Start of the reconciled line, to the second.

to_datetime.description: End of the reconciled line (or the termination), to the second.
